Phase 1-2: UI/UX Foundation and Component Library

- Updated design_system.py with new color tokens \(#9d5cff primary, badge colors, shadows, animations\)
- Added spacing tokens \(xxs=4, xs=8\) and animation tokens
- Refined QSS stylesheet typography \(H1: 24pt, H2: 16pt, body: 11pt, added H3 and caption roles\)
- Updated component styling \(inputs, buttons, cards, scrollbars from 12px to 8px\)
- Added badge styling rules with 5 variants \(primary, success, warning, error, info\)
- Updated gradient background and all color references to use new primary color
- Created 7 new components in components.py:
  * BadgeLabel - status badges with color variants
  * FAB - floating action button \(56x56px\)
  * SearchBar - enhanced search input with icon and clear button
  * EmptyStateWidget - empty state display with icon, title, description
  * SegmentedControl - multi-button pill container with active state
  * ProgressCard - project card with progress bar and metadata
- Updated existing components:
  * CardFrame - updated shadow color to new primary
  * ToggleSwitch - updated colors to new primary \(#9d5cff\)

All changes align with the 48 reference designs in JPE assets folder.
